title: Atlassian - Slow loading times and extended response times for Cloud products in the EU-West region.
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Slow loading times and extended response times for Cloud products in the EU-West region.
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2024-09-10T10:26:14.576Z
Resolved: 2024-09-10T12:43:48.654Z
Updates:
- 2024-09-10T12:43:48.654Z: resolved - Systems have recovered, and the issue has been mitigated. All affected products are fully operational, with no further impact observed.
- 2024-09-10T10:26:14.633Z: investigating - We are investigating issues with slow loading and long responsive time for all products (Jira, JSM, JSW and Confluence) and will provide updates here soon.

incident.name: Slow loading times and extended response times for Cloud products in the EU-West region.

incident_updates.body: Systems have recovered, and the issue has been mitigated. All affected products are fully operational, with no further impact observed.
